attempts.bug_summary: When a response requests connection closure while also being an HTTP 100 Continue response, queued exchanges are left pending instead of being failed immediately. The connection is still marked for closure, so those queued exchanges can remain stranded after the close decision.

When a cleartext HTTP/2 upgrade response arrives before the request body has been fully sent, the listener now fails to retain that an upgrade response was received. The later request-write transition therefore cannot recognize and complete the pending HTTP/2 upgrade, leaving the connection on the pre-upgrade path.
